title: Pin the fleet-mode ActiveWorktree requirement with a router test
summary: internal/router RouteInput.ActiveWorktree is documented as required under EVOLVE_FLEET=1 because the tmux driver refuses an empty worktree. No test in internal/router or its callers pins that the advisor input carries it. The one-line why was removed by the comment-reduction batch 'phase 3d r2 (defectledger, router)' and recorded in docs/architecture/packages/internal-router.md.
root_cause: The requirement lives only in the design notes; nothing fails when a fleet caller leaves ActiveWorktree empty.
fix: Add a test in internal/router that builds the advisor input under EVOLVE_FLEET=1 with an empty ActiveWorktree and asserts the advisor-side guard refuses it, or the caller-side test in core asserts it is set. Then keep the invariant in the design page and remove the field reason from the test-less path.
acceptance: A test fails when a fleet-mode advisor input has an empty ActiveWorktree.
internal/router and the caller test pass with -count=1.
connects_to: docs/architecture/packages/internal-router.md (Invariants: The fleet worktree is the caller's)
notes: Filed by the comment-reduction workstream (Phase 3d, batch r2). It is an invariant whose reason no test pins, so the one-line why goes with this item.
priority_rationale: A fleet lane with an empty worktree fails at dispatch; the failure is loud but late.
